headword: {基調講演|きちょうこうえん}

definitions.explanation: The main talk at a conference, symposium or academic meeting, given by an invited speaker near the start, which sets out the theme of the event.

examples.japanese: {基調講演|きちょうこうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I listen to the keynote speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{基調講演|きちょうこうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A famous writer gave the keynote address.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初日|しょにち}→初日：11741_shonichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{基調講演|きちょうこうえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{分科会|ぶんかかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: On the first day of the conference there is a keynote speech in the morning, and the sessions start in the afternoon.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{基調|きちょう}→基調：12084_kichou⟧ (keynote, underlying tone) and ⟦{講演|こうえん}→講演：02735_kouen⟧ (lecture). Used of conferences, symposia and trade events; the speaker is the {基調講演者|きちょうこうえんしゃ}.

- {基調講演|きちょうこうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to give a keynote speech
- {基調講演|きちょうこうえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as keynote speaker
